sources.title: Do you need a visa to travel to Belize?
sources.publisher: Government of Belize, Ministry of Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: Belize Immigration's live Government table gives visitor visa YES/NO results by nationality. It omits Timor-Leste and South Sudan and gives Nauru the contradictory value YES - NO.

sources.title: Ecuador transitory visitor visa nationalities from 1 September 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility
sources.officialityEvidence: Ecuador's current Foreign Ministry announcement gives its operative visitor-visa country list. It names the People's Republic of China but does not directly classify a Macao SAR passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a aquellos nacionales de los países a los que actualmente se les solicita visa

sources.title: Visas para extranjeros: country classification
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Guatemala
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official schedule was directly reviewed on 24 August and places Andorra in both Category A and Category B. The same endpoint returned HTTP 403 on the latest normal replay.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Categoría A Exento; Categoría B Visa consular; Categoría C Visa consultada.

sources.title: Clasificación de países
sources.officialityEvidence: Guatemala's migration authority defines Category A as visa-exempt and Category B as consular-visa treatment. It cannot reconcile a nationality placed in both cohorts by MINEX.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los países que se encuentran en la categoría A, no necesitan visa

sources.title: Nicaragua eAIP GEN 1.3: passenger entry, transit and exit
sources.publisher: Nicaraguan Institute of Civil Aeronautics / COCESNA eAIP
sources.officialityEvidence: Nicaragua's current State aeronautical publication gives its ordinary-passport A/B/C schedule. The assigned passports are blank or not directly mapped, so no route is inferred.
sources.supportingExcerpt: debe de solicitar ante el consulado un aval de la Direccion General

sources.title: Immigration and visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of Panama in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live Embassy page publishes separate named no-visa, authorised-visa and stamped-visa cohorts. It does not name Macao, Timor-Leste or South Sudan and states no all-other-passports complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If you are from one of the following countries ... you will need an authorized visa

sources.title: Servicios Consulares
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama
sources.officialityEvidence: Panama's live Foreign Ministry page describes the National Migration Service authorisation prerequisite for an authorised visa, but it does not add a nationality complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: previa autorización del Servicio Nacional de Migración

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: Belize's live table says both YES and NO
conflicts.explanation: Belize Immigration's current nationality table gives Nauru the internally contradictory value YES - NO, so it cannot support the imported visa-free label or a visa-required replacement.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: Guatemala places Andorra in both Category A and Category B
conflicts.explanation: Guatemala's current Foreign Ministry schedule places Andorra in both visa-exempt Category A and consular-visa Category B, so no single ordinary-passport result is safe.
